issues.failure_explanation: From Theorem thm:main and Corollary cor:1, the field-of-values distance satisfies dist(0,W) ≥ C₃Λ⁻¹p_f⁻² and the operator norm satisfies ‖C‖ ≤ C₂Λ. Hence sin δ = dist/‖C‖ ≥ (C₃/C₂)Λ⁻²p_f⁻², so the Elman-type estimate of Corollary cor:Elman gives m ≳ δ⁻¹ log(12/ε) ≈ (C₂/C₃)Λ²p_f² log(12/ε). The stated bound m ≥ 𝒞 C₃⁻¹ Λ p_f² log(12/ε) has Λ instead of Λ², so the derived iteration bound is off by a factor of Λ.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace Λ by Λ² in eq:it_bound (i.e., change m ≥ 𝒞 C₃⁻¹ Λ p_f² log(12/ε) to m ≥ 𝒞 C₃⁻¹ Λ² p_f² log(12/ε)) in both Corollary cor:2 and the corresponding statement in Corollary cor:3.
issues.overall_effect: The explicit iteration-count bound in eq:it_bound is wrong by a factor of Λ. When Λ is fixed (as in all stated applications), the qualitative claim O(p_f²) iterations is unaffected, but the formal corollaries misstate the dependence on the overlap number Λ.
issues.title: GMRES iteration bound has wrong Λ-dependence in cor:2 and cor:3
issues.why_classification: The incorrect Λ-power is a contained error in the final step converting field-of-values bounds to an iteration count. Correcting it changes only the explicit Λ factor in the iteration bound; all qualitative claims (k-independent iterations, O(p_f²) growth) survive since Λ is fixed in every application. No new lemma or construction is required.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: k^{-|\alpha|}\Vert  \partial^\alpha \uhigh \Vert_{L^2(\Omega)} \leq C_1 k^{-1}\Csol\Vert f \Vert_{L^2(\Omega)} \quad \tfa  k \in K\cap [k_1,\infty) \text{ and for all } |\alpha|\leq 2.
The strategy is to apply Theorem \ref{thm:interpolationMS1} with $m=2$ to $\uhigh$

issues.failure_explanation: The proof of cor:MS1 applies the m=2 interpolation estimate (Theorem thm:interpolationMS1) to u_high, which has |u_high|_{H²} ≤ C₁ k C_sol ‖f‖ (from Theorem thm:LSW3). This gives the interpolation-error contribution k⁻¹|(I−I_h)u_high|_{H¹} ≤ C(h/p_f) C_sol ‖f‖ in the H¹_k norm, i.e. an operator-norm contribution of order (h/p_f)C_sol. The stated bound's first term is only O(kh/p_f), which equals O((h/p_f)C_sol) only when C_sol/k is bounded. When C_sol/k grows (i.e. C_sol ≫ k, as allowed by the hypothesis C_sol ≤ C(kL)^P with P > 1), the u_high contribution exceeds the claimed bound by an unbounded factor C_sol/k. The same root defect produces the incorrect constant '1' in the H²_k bound eq:Bristol3 (in the proof of thm:final2, case p_c > p_f), where it should be k⁻¹C_sol.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Restrict the growth assumption on C_sol from 'polynomially bounded' to C_sol = O(kL) (nontrapping), or include the term (h/p_f)C_sol in the bounds of cor:MS1, cor:MS2, and eq:Bristol3, and correspondingly strengthen the conditions on h (or H) in thm:final1 and thm:final2 to ensure (h/p_f)C_sol (resp. (H/p_c)C_sol) is sufficiently small. The latter requires h ≲ p_f/C_sol in addition to the stated condition kh/p_f ≤ C₁, which inflates the fine-space DoF count beyond the advertised (kL)^d(log k)^{3d} scale when C_sol ≫ k.
issues.overall_effect: The bounds on η(V_h) and η(V_0) used to verify Assumption ass:coarse (via Lemma lem:coarse) are understated, so the proofs of Corollaries cor:MS3, cor:MS4, and Theorems thm:final1, thm:final2, and thm:informal_pwp have gaps when C_sol/k is unbounded (i.e. C_sol grows faster than kL). For C_sol = O(kL) (nontrapping problems) the bounds are correct and all results stand; for trapping-type growth C_sol ~ (kL)^P with P > 1 the advertised quasi-optimality and near-pollution-free DoF counts are unsupported by the given arguments.
issues.title: u_high interpolation error O((h/p_f)C_sol) is not captured by the stated bounds on ‖(I−I_h)S*‖ and ‖(I−I₀)S*‖_{H²_k}
issues.why_classification: Restricting to C_sol = O(kL) (nontrapping) is a limited weakening that preserves every advertised rate and DoF count for the nontrapping regime, which is the regime where near-pollution-free discretization makes sense and which the paper treats as the primary application. The fix is local to the bound on η and requires no new proof architecture. The trapping regime (C_sol ≫ kL) is lost or requires materially more DoFs, but a recognizably comparable result survives for nontrapping problems.
